# Altora Indonesia

> Altora Indonesia (brand: Altora) is an Indonesian technology company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Samarinda, East Kalimantan, with branch offices in Balikpapan (Balikpapan Utara and Pasar Baru). It serves organizations in Balikpapan, Samarinda, and across Indonesia with operational software, artificial intelligence, hardware, and systems integration. Altora is distinct from similarly named companies.

## Identity
- Legal/brand name: Altora Indonesia
- Short name: Altora
- Former identity: Algora Teknologi Indonesia (Algora)
- Official website: https://altora.id/
- Rebrand information: https://altora.id/algora
- Head office: Perum Graha Indah Blok A13, Air Putih, Samarinda Ulu, Samarinda
- Branches: Jl. Soekarno Hatta, Muara Rapak, Balikpapan Utara; Pasar Baru, Balikpapan
- Official partners: Teltonika, TP-Link | VIGI, Starlink, Lenovo
- Registered supplier on Inaproc/LKPP (Indonesian government procurement)
- Contact: hello@altora.id, WhatsApp +62 851-9091-1170 (https://wa.me/6285190911170)

## What Altora does
- Custom software and operational systems
- HRIS, KPI, work planning, and people operations systems
- Fleet management and vehicle operations monitoring
- AI CCTV, smart attendance, safety vision, and smart access
- IoT monitoring, sensors, command centers, and data dashboards
- Hardware procurement, custom kiosk systems, PC/tablet deployment, and software-hardware integration
- Websites, SEO, data platforms, and system integration
